verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for an API-driven SaaS like Stripe Invoicing, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions restricted, scoped or least-privilege keys. The MCP server, CLI and sandbox items cover agent access and test environments, not permission-scoped credentials, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
